description.value: A small-batch craft distillery on the Sidney waterfront, producing award-winning gins including the well-known Empress 1908 Indigo Gin. The retail space offers complimentary tastings and bottle purchases, making it a worthwhile stop for cyclists riding through the Saanich Peninsula. The copper pot stills and waterfront setting give the visit a sense of place beyond a typical liquor store.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces, covered) at 78m; rack (16 spaces) at 92m; stands (5 spaces) at 99m. Total: 29 spaces.
